fields.finding: Curvature equals bay side to preserve the 011b film equation. Circumscribed circular-cap rise does not establish compatibility with all three actual edge arcs. Film masses and gas rates use 4*pi*R^2 without pillow-area correction. Triangular tributary and scored arc line loads differ; the stated 011b load path is retained.
fields.proposed_next: Specify boundary, shape, true area and load transfer consistently with the sag amendment.
